scope: Historical financial ingestion priority and order

stages.name: income_statement
stages.fields: All dated numeric fields returned by fundamentalsTimeSeries module=financials for annual and quarterly periods
stages.reason: Direct raw historical financial facts; do not replace with a derived ratio.

stages.name: balance_sheet
stages.fields: All dated numeric fields returned by fundamentalsTimeSeries module=balance-sheet for annual and quarterly periods
stages.reason: Direct raw historical financial facts including equity, book-value inputs and filing-period share facts.

stages.name: cash_flow
stages.fields: All dated numeric fields returned by fundamentalsTimeSeries module=cash-flow for annual and quarterly periods
stages.reason: Direct raw historical cash-flow, free-cash-flow, capex and dividend-paid facts.

stages.name: dividends
stages.reason: Direct dated events and raw statement facts.

P2_REBUILD_AND_VALIDATE.reason: These are valuation or ratio outputs. Build only after their period-aligned raw dependencies have been ingested and validated.

P3_DEFERRED.reason: The observed surfaces are snapshot, limited-event, forward, or absent rather than complete dated historical series.

currentOrTrailingValuationStatistic.reason: Not a complete dated historical series.
